note: Compare, Ask, Plan and the copies per space (kinds PR B, S4b-BL-279; docs/03 ADR-36 §18.12 and §18.13, schemas README §8.4). A space is one kind's candidates: a filter over the one store, no table, no wire field. `contains`: whether a space holds a candidate (`multi` false: one space, it holds every candidate; two or more: a candidate of a kind that has a space here is in its own, any other kind's is in the default space; no `kind` is the house). `compare`: Compare's pick in a space, from the ids picked in order: `kept` are the live candidates in the running (status not REJECTED or NOT_CHOSEN) that the space holds, in order, without duplicates, at most four; `refused` are live candidates of another space (the page says so in one sentence, 'Compare works on the list you are looking at. Picks from another list were left out.'); an id that is no candidate, a deleted one, or one out of the running is dropped without a word, as before. `fileName`: a space's copy puts the English plural noun of the kind file's `kind.many`, lower case, letters and digits joined by hyphens, before the first date of the name; the house's names, a name without a date, a noun without letters, and every backup are unchanged byte for byte. `assistant`: whether Ask and Plan are shown in a space (`on`: the assistant is on; `ownKey`: it is the person's own, in the browser or on the phone; `serverKinds`, optional and read as none when absent: the kinds the server's status names, `GET /api/ai/status` `kinds`, S4b-BL-290; an older server names none and its Ask and Plan, which take no kind, would read every space): the house whenever the assistant is on; any other kind only when the build offers it and the assistant is the person's own, or the server named that kind. `shareKind`: the kind a shared listing lands in: the chosen one when it is enabled, else the default. Readers: the website's space-scope.spec.ts; the phones read this file in kinds PR C (S4b-BL-274).

a kind that has no space here is in the default space (the school)

with one space nothing is refused
